role: XCTest suite for RawRRBackup: backup/retrieve, archive marking, incremental-backup throttling, unarchived counts, purge, CSV export, hash determinism, index-window queries, allBackups ordering, entry duration/size, and the never-replace-a-larger-backup and capture-date rules.
state: backup: RawRRBackup() over the app's real App Group backup directory
idsBeforeTest: lazy Set of session ids present before the test (snapshot in setUp)
toplevel: Stored RawRRBackup() resolves the real App Group/Documents backup directory; idsBeforeTest is forced in setUp so tearDown can discard only backups the test added.

units.does: setUp: forces idsBeforeTest to snapshot the backup ids already in the store.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test

units.does: tearDown: discards every backup id indexed now that was not present before the test, asserting each discard does not throw.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test

branches.effect: discards each test-added backup; ids present before the test are left alone
